title: Supply, Installation, Testing and Commissioning of IoT-based Ultrasonic-type Digital water meters Confirming to ISO:4064-2014 for water supply lines to the additional Buildings at IIT Hyderabad, Kandi, Sangareddy.
scope_summary: This tender is for the supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of IoT-based ultrasonic digital water meters, confirming to ISO:4064-2014, for water supply lines in additional buildings at IIT Hyderabad. It also includes associated software and maintenance.
